Events.Title: The Storm in the Roots
Events.Callout: Two storm prowlers hold the cyan glade. Observe their warning poses, record a challenge or take the return path.
Events.Objective: Record the finite challenge. Evade the storm pounce during its long recovery.
Events.Success: The Shardwood glade is quiet. The guild records your first contribution.
Events.Failure: The pack withdrew. No reinforcements remain.
